title: Embed the web SPA as the renderer (dev + prod)
intent: The existing web/ React app renders inside the Electron window with correct routing and assets.
checklist: Dev loads http://localhost:3000 with working HMR and React Router
Prod loads the bundled web build via app:// protocol with correct base path
Client-side routing (history) works without 404 on reload/deep paths
Static assets (fonts, images, map tiles, chart libs) load under CSP
No mixed-content or CSP violations in the console
Renderer crash → reload/recover handler

title: API client wiring for the desktop origin
intent: request()/TanStack hooks reach /api/v1 + SSE from the desktop app with correct origin/cookies.
checklist: Configurable API base URL (env/settings) injected into the renderer
Cookies/credentials handled for the app:// or custom origin (session.cookies)
CORS/origin headers reconciled so /api/v1 calls succeed
No /api/v1 double-prefix; snake_case query params preserved
Connection failure surfaces the web QueryError UI, not a blank window

title: Authentik / OIDC desktop auth flow
intent: ForwardAuth-style login works in a desktop context via system browser + loopback/PKCE.
checklist: Authorization Code + PKCE via the system browser (shell.openExternal), not an embedded login webview
Loopback or custom-scheme redirect captures the auth code
Token exchange in the main process; renderer never sees the client secret
Session/cookie established so /api/v1 ForwardAuth passes
Logout clears tokens + session cookies
Auth error + retry surfaced in-app

title: Secure token storage (safeStorage / OS keychain)
intent: Refresh tokens are encrypted at rest via the OS, never in localStorage.
checklist: safeStorage.encryptString/decryptString (or keytar) for refresh tokens
Tokens stored in userData, never in the renderer or localStorage
Graceful handling when OS encryption is unavailable (BLOCKED, not plaintext)
Token refresh loop in the main process
Clear-on-logout and clear-on-uninstall behavior

title: SSE live data in the desktop app
intent: EventSource live telemetry/SSE works with reconnect + staleness in the desktop context.
checklist: SSE EventSource connects with auth and survives token refresh
Automatic reconnect with backoff on drop
>2 min staleness indicator preserved (matches web StatusBar)
SSE paused on system suspend, resumed on wake (ties to chrome:powermonitor)
No leaked connections on window reload/close

title: Deep-link protocol (teslasync://) → in-app routes
intent: OS deep links open the app and navigate to the right route, single-instance safe.
checklist: setAsDefaultProtocolClient('teslasync') registered per OS
open-url (macOS) + second-instance argv (win/linux) parse the deep link
Deep link mapped to a web route and forwarded to the renderer via IPC
Cold-start deep link queued until the window is ready
Malformed deep links rejected safely

title: Window state persistence (bounds, maximized, multi-monitor)
intent: The window restores where the user left it, across monitors and DPI.
checklist: Persist + restore bounds, maximized, and fullscreen state
Clamp to the nearest visible display if the saved monitor is gone
Sensible default size honoring min width/height
Per-display DPI handled without misplacement

title: OS locale → web i18n + native string bridge
intent: The app picks up the OS locale and shares it with web i18n and native chrome.
checklist: app.getLocale() seeds the renderer's i18n on first run
User language override forwarded to native menus/tray (E2 chrome)
Locale change without restart where possible
Fallback chain matches the web app

title: E1 acceptance gate — authenticated SPA with live data in the desktop shell
intent: Prove integration is real: login, the SPA renders, /api/v1 + SSE flow, deep links work.
checklist: E2E: launch → login via system browser → dashboard renders real data
E2E: SSE live segment updates; staleness indicator behaves
E2E: teslasync:// deep link navigates to the target route
Window state persists across restart
All E1 ledger rows are status=done
